query_normalized: predicting molecular refractive indices from graph-based molecular representations chemistry
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (d) as a foundational methodology reference for using graph-based molecular representations (specifically M3GNet and MACE) to predict chemical properties, and criterion (b) as it demonstrates the application of these representations to predict specific molecular properties (NMR shifts) on drug molecules, which is the same domain and mechanism as predicting refractive indices.
